headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk assessment tools to provide users with up-to-date security and compatibility information. Leverage AI-driven analysis for more accurate binding.gyp command expansions, ensuring a safer installation process.
actions: Integrate Gathin23/cleanyourtv's real-time vulnerability scanning capabilities to check dependencies against known threats before installation.
Utilize deepseek-ai/DeepInfer's advanced AI models to predict and suggest safer binding.gyp command expansions, reducing the risk of misconfiguration during npm
Implement ly05010419/MacNativeGames' native dependency management techniques to ensure compatibility and security checks are performed locally first.
